FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 347
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/09/2026
Senate Bill 347 as introduced would, beginning in 2027, require the distribution of simplified
sellers use taxes (SSUT) proceeds to counties and municipalities to be distributed based upon
US Census population estimates and updated every five years. This would increase SSUT
receipts to certain counties and municipalities, while simultaneously decreasing receipts to other
counties and municipalities, by amounts dependent upon the differences in: (1) the current
estimated population of each county and municipality, updated every ten years using U.S.
Census data, and (2) the estimated population of each county and municipality, updated every
five years using U.S. Census Bureau Population and Housing Estimates Program estimates.
This bill would not affect the aggregate distributions to counties and municipalities.
